spells.notes: Kim Young-sam era holdover (caretaker cabinet under PM 고건 from 1998-02-25). 통일원 was abolished when 정부조직법 법률 제5529호 took effect on the afternoon of 1998-02-28 (on gazette delivery per 연합뉴스). The 정무직 were excluded from the staff transfer, and contemporary reports say the new 통일부 head post was vacant, so he did not continue as 통일부장관 (reorg_continuation false). end is set to 1998-02-27 to match the legal day convention in offices.json. The ministry page and ko.wikipedia list 1998-03-02 (the day before his successor's appointment), and he held a farewell ceremony on 1998-03-03 (연합뉴스 1998-03-03 18:44 "金鍾泌총리서리 취임식 안팎" (權五琦전통일부총리와 康仁德신임통일장관이 서로 엇갈려 이.취임식); https://n.news.naver.com/mnews/article/001/0004374671; snapshot sources/unification/news/naver_001_0004374671.html; accessed 2026-09-24T22:45:11-0400). The reshuffle was announced on 1995-12-20. The ministry page gives 1995-12-21 as his start, which is used here. birth_date from Wikidata Q12586107 (via ko.wikipedia title '권오기 (1932년)'), sources/unification/wikidata_persons.json, accessed 2026-09-25T14:01:59-0400 (secondary). Verifier note. The start day is disputed between 1995-12-20 (announcement, reported by 중앙일보 and 한겨레 as the day he was appointed) and 1995-12-21 (임명장 and 취임식, ministry page). No 관보 file exists for 1995. The value 1995-12-21 is kept because it is the ministry page date and matches the 임명장-day convention most lineages used for the 1997-08-05/06 YS reshuffle. The end follows the cross-lineage convention for ministries abolished on 1998-02-28 (all such rosters end on 1998-02-27).

The 임명장 was handed over on 1999-05-26 (연합뉴스 1999-05-26 11:33 "김 대통령 신임 국정원장 등에 임명장"; https://n.news.naver.com/mnews/article/001/0004511356; snapshot sources/unification/news/naver_001_0004511356.html; accessed 2026-09-24T22:47:26-0400), so the legal date may be 05-24 or 05-26. The ministry page uses 05-24. Left to become 국가정보원장 (announced 1999-12-23, 임명장 1999-12-24). Wikidata gives conflicting birth dates ['1933-01-01', '1934-01-01'], so birth_date is left null. Verifier note. The 1999-05-24 start is supported by the DJ-era practice seen in the 관보, where the appointment date follows the announcement even when the 임명장 comes later (홍순영, named and gazetted 2001-09-07, 임명장 2001-09-12). end_reason set to other because he moved to 국가정보원장.

issues.desc: 1998-02-28..1998-03-02 vacancy. When 정부조직법 법률 제5529호 took effect on the afternoon of 1998-02-28, 통일원 was abolished and no 통일부 minister or vice minister was in office until 강인덕 was appointed on 1998-03-03 (contemporary reports call the new ministries' heads 궐위). 권오기's 통일원 spell is closed on 1998-02-27 to match offices.json, although he was in office for part of 1998-02-28 and the ministry page lists him to 1998-03-02. No acting head was identified for these three days. The same treatment should be applied consistently to the other YS-era ministries abolished that day.

End-date convention. The 통일부 역대장관 page ends each tenure on the day before the successor's start. This roster instead uses the documented last day (resignation accepted, farewell ceremony) and otherwise the successor's legal appointment date (same-day handover). Most spells that end in a replacement therefore end one day later than on the ministry page. Adjust in code if a strict non-overlap convention is wanted.

이재정 end date. His resignation acceptance date was not found. The roster uses 2008-02-29, the day of his farewell ceremony and the first day of 차관 대행. The ministry page says 2008-02-28. The 관보 does not print exits.
권영세 start. The 관보 (제20255호) and same-day reports give 2022-05-13. The ministry page and ko.wikipedia give 2022-05-16 (probably the 임명장 ceremony). The old panel likely follows 05-16.

Pre-2001 dates, for which no digital 관보 exists, are 권오기 start 1995-12-21 (disputed, announced and reported as appointed on 1995-12-20, 임명장 and 취임식 1995-12-21), 임동원 start 1999-05-24 (announcement day, 임명장 1999-05-26), 박재규 start 1999-12-23 (announcement day, corrected by the verifier from 1999-12-24, the 임명장 day) and 임동원 end 1999-12-23. They rest on news of the day plus the ministry page. The rule used is the one the 관보 shows for the 김대중 government, where the appointment is dated by the announcement even when the 임명장 is later (홍순영 2001-09-07, 임명장 2001-09-12).

정세현 was reappointed by 노무현 on 2003-02-27 (관보 제15338호) after serving since 2002-01-29. He is kept as one spell per the instructions. The ministry page counts two 대수 (29대, 30대). The split at 2003-02-25 done in code will not match the 2003-02-27 reappointment date, and the 2003-02-25..02-26 days are a holdover period under 노무현.

Holdover periods after presidential transitions are 이재정 2008-02-25..02-29, 류우익 2013-02-25..03-11, 홍용표 2017-05-10..07-03, 김영호 2025-06-04..07-25. The ministers served under a president who had not appointed them.

Naver News searches were intermittently throttled (empty result pages) during this run, so several appointment-day and farewell reports come from BigKinds metadata (title and snippet only, snapshotted JSON) rather than full articles.

Secondary person fields. gender is from na_members_15_22.csv (정동영, 이재정, 이인영, 권영세), Wikidata P21 (the others) and, for 강인덕 who has no P21, from the 1998-03-03 Yonhap cabinet profile that names only two women in the cabinet. birth_date is from na_members_15_22.csv or Wikidata P569 (year only where Wikidata has year precision or conflicting values). name_en is the Wikidata English label, not an official romanization. name_hanja is from the 관보 notice (2001 onward) or Yonhap (권오기, 강인덕, 박재규).

Day-level continuity for 통일부 (1998-02-28..2026-09-24). Vacancy 1998-02-28..1998-03-02 between the abolition of 통일원 and 강인덕, 3 day(s), with no acting head identified (장·차관 궐위). Vacancy 2005-12-31..2006-02-09 between 정동영 and 이종석, 41 day(s), with 이봉조 차관 직무대행. Vacancy 2008-03-01..2008-03-10 between 이재정 and 김하중, 10 day(s), with 홍양호 차관 (차관 대행체제). Vacancy 2020-06-20..2020-07-26 between 김연철 and 이인영, 37 day(s), with 서호 차관 직무대행. Vacancy 2022-05-10..2022-05-12 between 이인영 and 권영세, 3 day(s), with 김기웅 차관 직무대행. Same-day handovers, where the outgoing end equals the incoming start, are 강인덕->임동원 on 1999-05-24, 임동원->박재규 on 1999-12-23, 박재규->임동원 on 2001-03-26, 임동원->홍순영 on 2001-09-07, 홍순영->정세현 on 2002-01-29, 이종석->이재정 on 2006-12-11, 현인택->류우익 on 2011-09-17, 류우익->류길재 on 2013-03-11, 류길재->홍용표 on 2015-03-13, 홍용표->조명균 on 2017-07-03, 조명균->김연철 on 2019-04-08, 권영세->김영호 on 2023-07-28, 김영호->정동영 on 2025-07-25. No other gaps or overlaps were found. 통일원 (1998-02-25..02-27) was held by 권오기 throughout. Adjacent spells with no vacant day are 정세현->정동영 (2004-06-30/07-01) and 김하중->현인택 (2009-02-11/02-12). The first two days of the 2005-12-31..2006-02-09 vacancy (a weekend after the late-evening acceptance on 2005-12-30) precede the reported start of 차관 대행 on 2006-01-02.
Verifier dispute on 이재정 end. 2008-02-29 (이임식, last working day) is kept against 2008-02-28 on the 통일부 역대장관 page and Namu Wiki. No report of the 사표 수리 or 면직 day was found.
Verifier dispute on 권오기 start. 1995-12-21 (ministry page, 임명장, 취임식) is kept against 1995-12-20 (announcement reported as the appointment by 중앙일보 and 한겨레). The start lies before the window.
